_comment: Events something LISTENS for that nothing emits. Each entry is a deliberate, explained gap, not a shrug. Two kinds live here: engines listed in MIGRATION-LAW.md as not yet ported (the listener is the client half, waiting), and features whose UI shipped without their producer. Build the emitter -> delete the entry. Do NOT let this list grow without a matching decision: a new dead listener is a new dead feature.
_unported_engines: MIGRATION-LAW.md STEP 4-7. The client half is written and waiting for the server engine to be ported.
_unbuilt_producers: UI shipped, producer never written. Each is a real gap worth closing.
SHOWDOWN_START: HoleCardReveal + table chat wait for it; no engine event announces showdown yet
MILESTONE_UNLOCKED: MilestoneToast is mounted at the app root and has never fired
ACHIEVEMENT_UNLOCKED: FriendActivityFeed listens; AchievementTriggerService emits CHALLENGE_PROGRESS_UPDATED instead
HAND_REPLAY_STEP: HandReplay3D step-through; the replay drives itself locally today
HAND_WON: table chat reaction hook; HAND_COMPLETE carries the winner instead
RAKEBACK_DISTRIBUTED: rakeback runs server-side on a schedule and never notifies the table
BREAK_START: TournamentClock break banner — the engine sets tournaments.on_break but emits nothing
TOURNAMENT_BREAK: duplicate of BREAK_START from an earlier naming; clock listens for both
TOURNAMENT_BREAK_END: duplicate of BREAK_END from an earlier naming
_harmless_duplicates: A second listener for an event covered by another that IS emitted.
WS_RECONNECTING: MultiTablePage also listens for WS_DISCONNECTED, which the watchdog does emit, so the reconnecting chip works; this subscription is redundant, not broken
